meta.title: A Credit Freeze Locks The Door Before Identity Thieves Arrive
meta.hook: A free credit freeze can stop a thief from opening most new accounts in your name.
meta.description: A credit freeze restricts access to your credit report, so prospective creditors generally cannot approve new accounts until you lift it. It is free to place and lift with each nationwide credit bureau, and it does not affect your existing accounts or credit score.

scenes.narration: A free credit freeze can stop an identity thief from opening most new accounts in your name.

visual.visual_intent: A digital credit report snapping behind a padlock
visual.decision_reason: FTC says freezes restrict access and help prevent new-account fraud

scenes.narration: New lenders usually check a credit report before approving an account. A freeze blocks that access.

visual.visual_intent: A lender screen requesting a credit report
visual.decision_reason: FTC explains prospective creditors generally need report access

scenes.narration: With no report available, the application generally cannot move forward, even if the thief has your Social Security number.

visual.visual_intent: A fraudulent application stopped by an access-denied screen

scenes.narration: You place the freeze separately with each nationwide credit bureau, and federal law makes placing and lifting it free.

visual.visual_intent: Three separate file folders each receiving a lock
visual.decision_reason: FTC says placement and lifting are free and handled with bureaus

scenes.narration: It does not close existing accounts, stop every kind of fraud, or prevent you from using current credit cards.

visual.visual_intent: A current credit card working normally at checkout
visual.decision_reason: FTC distinguishes freezes from protection against all fraud

scenes.narration: Think of it as locking the new-account door. You keep the key and temporarily lift the freeze when needed.

visual.visual_intent: A hand briefly unlocking a file cabinet
visual.decision_reason: Accurate closing metaphor for temporary lifting
